messages.content: Amma is making rotis for 5 people, and each person eats 3. She has already made 9. How many more does she need?
She needs 6 more rotis. Because 5 people times 3 rotis is 15, and 15 minus the 9 already made leaves 6.
Why do the leaves of a plant kept in a dark cupboard turn pale?
The plant is starved of light. Because leaves need sunlight to make food and keep their green colour, so in the dark they slowly turn yellow or pale.
Every member of the chess club is in Class 8. Irfan is in Class 8. Is Irfan in the chess club?
We cannot tell. Because the rule only says that club members are in Class 8; it does not say every Class 8 student is in the club, so Irfan may or may not be.
A bus comes every 15 minutes, starting at 7:00. I reach the stop at 7:38. How long do I wait?
You wait 7 minutes. Because the buses come at 7:00, 7:15, 7:30 and 7:45, so the next one after 7:38 is at 7:45, which is 7 minutes away.
Why does a wet towel dry faster when it is spread out instead of folded?
Spreading it out lets it dry much faster. Because more of the cloth touches the air, so water can escape from a bigger surface at the same time.
A pen costs ₹12 and Nikhil has ₹100. What is the largest number of pens he can buy?
He can buy 8 pens. Because 8 times 12 is 96, which fits within ₹100, but 9 pens would cost ₹108, which is too much.
My little brother cried when I laughed at his drawing, even though I was laughing at a funny part. Why?

He probably thought you were making fun of him. Because he could not see what you were thinking, and to a small child, laughter at his work can feel like teasing. Telling him what you liked would help.
In a race, Divya passes the runner in second place. What position is she in now?
She is in second place. Because she took the place of the runner she passed, who was second; she has not passed the leader.
Why are puddles gone much faster on a sunny afternoon than on a cloudy one?
The sun dries them faster. Because sunshine warms the water, and warm water evaporates into the air more quickly than cool water.
A test has 40 questions and Pooja got 32 right. What percentage did she score?
She scored 80 percent. Because 32 out of 40 is the same as 8 out of 10, and 8 out of 10 is 80 percent.
Grandpa was born in 1958. How old will he be on his birthday in 2027?
He will turn 69 that year. Because 2027 minus 1958 is 69, and his age goes up by one on each birthday.
Why does a dog pant on a hot day?
It pants to cool down. Because dogs do not sweat much through their skin, so fast breathing lets water evaporate from the tongue and mouth, and that carries heat away.
One shop sells 2 kg of rice for ₹110 and another sells 5 kg for ₹260. Which is cheaper per kilogram?
The 5 kg bag is cheaper. Because 110 divided by 2 is ₹55 a kilogram, while 260 divided by 5 is ₹52 a kilogram.
Lata types 50 words a minute. How long will a 1,200-word report take her to type?
It will take her 24 minutes. Because she types a steady 50 words each minute, and 1,200 divided by 50 gives 24.
Why does a metal spoon in hot soup get hot, but a wooden one does not?
Metal carries heat well and wood does not. Because heat passes easily through metal up to the handle, while wood slows it down, so a wooden handle stays cool.
A car uses 1 litre of petrol for every 15 km. How much petrol does a 180 km trip need?
It needs 12 litres. Because 180 divided by 15 is 12, so the car uses one litre for each of those 12 stretches of 15 km.
Zoya, Ben and Kiran shared a pizza cut into 12 slices equally. Then Zoya gave one of hers to Ben. How many does Ben have?
Ben has 5 slices. Because 12 slices shared by 3 people is 4 each, and one more from Zoya makes 5.
If today is Thursday, what day will it be 10 days from now?
It will be Sunday. Because 7 days from Thursday is Thursday again, and 3 more days take you through Friday and Saturday to Sunday.
Why do people wash their hands before eating?
To keep germs off their food. Because hands touch many surfaces during the day and pick up dirt and germs, and washing with soap removes most of them before they reach the mouth.
We are making 60 laddoos for Diwali and each box holds 8. How many boxes do we need?
You need 8 boxes. Because 7 boxes hold only 56 laddoos, so the last 4 laddoos need an eighth box.
A novel has 320 pages. If Arjun reads 20 pages each night, how many nights will he take?
He will take 16 nights. Because he covers 20 pages a night, and 320 divided by 20 is 16.
The light in the hall will not switch on, but the fan in the same room works. What is the most likely problem?
The bulb has probably burnt out. Because the fan works, power is reaching the room, so the fault is most likely in the bulb or its holder, not the main supply.
Five friends each shake hands once with every other friend. How many handshakes happen?
There are 10 handshakes. Because the first person shakes 4 hands, the next makes 3 new ones, then 2, then 1, and 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 10.
Why do we see lightning before we hear thunder?
Light travels much faster than sound. Because both start at the same moment, but the light reaches your eyes almost at once, while the sound takes a few seconds to cover the distance.
Why does a cut apple turn brown if you leave it out?
The cut surface reacts with the air. Because oxygen in the air reacts with substances inside the apple once the skin is broken, and that turns the flesh brown.
Priya saves ₹150 every week. How many weeks will it take her to save ₹1,200?
It will take her 8 weeks. Because she adds ₹150 each week, and 150 times 8 makes exactly ₹1,200.
Each period is 40 minutes long and the first one starts at 8:00. When does the fourth period start if there are no breaks?
The fourth period starts at 10:00. Because three full periods come before it, and 3 times 40 minutes is 120 minutes, which is 2 hours after 8:00.
Why might a new student sit alone at lunch on the first day?
They may feel shy or not know anyone yet. Because joining a group of strangers is hard, and most people wait until they feel welcome. A friendly invitation can make a big difference.
A football match has two halves of 45 minutes and a 15-minute break. If it starts at 4:00 p.m., when does it end, ignoring extra time?
It ends at 5:45 p.m. Because 45 + 15 + 45 is 105 minutes, which is 1 hour 45 minutes after 4:00.
Why do cats often sleep in a patch of sunlight?
They like the warmth. Because a sunny spot is warmer than the rest of the floor, and resting there keeps them comfortable without using much of their own energy.
Neha is 4 years older than her cousin Raj, who is 11. How old will Neha be in 3 years?
Neha will be 18. Because she is 11 + 4 = 15 now, and in 3 years she will be 15 + 3 = 18.
A shop opens at 9:30 a.m. and closes at 6:00 p.m. How many hours is it open?
It is open for 8 and a half hours. Because 9:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. is 8 hours, and 5:30 to 6:00 adds another half hour.
What makes ice float in a glass of water?
Ice is lighter than the same amount of liquid water. Because water expands when it freezes, so ice is less dense, and the liquid water holds it up.
Why do trains leave at the fixed time even when some seats are still empty?
So that everyone can plan around the timetable. Because passengers, staff and connecting journeys all depend on it, and waiting for more people would make everyone else late.
A shirt costs ₹800 and is on sale at 25 percent off. What is the sale price?
The sale price is ₹600. Because 25 percent of 800 is 200, and 800 minus 200 is 600.
If no fish can climb trees, and Goldie is a fish, can Goldie climb trees?
No, Goldie cannot. Because the rule covers every fish, and Goldie is one of them, so the rule applies to Goldie too.
Why do gardeners water plants in the early morning rather than at noon?
Less water is lost that way. Because at noon the hot sun dries the soil quickly, while in the cool morning the water has time to soak down to the roots.
A film is 2 hours 20 minutes long and starts at 7:50 p.m. When does it finish?
It finishes at 10:10 p.m. Because 7:50 plus 2 hours is 9:50, and 20 more minutes makes 10:10.
Mohan says his party was the best ever because 50 people came. Does more guests always mean a better party?
Not always. Because a good party depends on how much people enjoy it, not only on numbers; a small party with close friends can be more fun than a crowded one.
Our water tank holds 1,000 litres and the family uses 250 litres a day. If it is full on Monday morning and no water comes in, when does it run out?
It runs out at the end of Thursday. Because 1,000 divided by 250 is 4, so the water lasts four days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
Why does dough rise when yeast is added?
The yeast makes gas inside the dough. Because yeast feeds on the sugar in the dough and gives off tiny bubbles of carbon dioxide, which get trapped and puff the dough up.
On a 34-degree afternoon, why does a room with drawn curtains stay cooler?
The curtains block much of the sun's heat. Because sunlight coming through the windows warms the room, and curtains stop a lot of it from getting in.
Ishaan's marks were 70, 80 and 90 in three tests. What is his average?
His average is 80. Because 70 + 80 + 90 is 240, and 240 divided by 3 tests is 80.
Is a ₹200 bag that lasts four years cheaper over time than an ₹80 bag that lasts one year?
Yes, the ₹200 bag is cheaper over time. Because four ₹80 bags, one for each year, would cost ₹320, which is more than ₹200.
A farmer has 7 hens and 3 goats. How many legs are there in total?
There are 26 legs. Because 7 hens have 2 legs each, which is 14, and 3 goats have 4 legs each, which is 12, and 14 + 12 = 26.
How come people often feel calmer after a short walk outside?
Moving and a change of scene help them relax. Because walking eases tense muscles, daylight can lift the mood, and stepping away gives the mind a break from what was bothering it.
Two friends stand 6 km apart and walk towards each other, each at 3 km an hour. When do they meet?
They meet after 1 hour. Because together they close the gap by 3 + 3 = 6 km every hour, and the gap is exactly 6 km.
Why do streets get very crowded the evening before a big festival?
Many people shop at the last minute. Because families need sweets, flowers, clothes and gifts for the next day, and most of them go out after work at the same time.
The library allows each member 3 books at a time. A family of 4 members wants 14 books. Can they borrow them all at once?
No, they can borrow only 12. Because 4 members times 3 books is 12, which is 2 short of 14.
Why do runners warm up before a race?
To get their bodies ready for hard running. Because gentle movement warms the muscles and raises the heart rate slowly, so the body handles the hard effort better.
Twenty-four students are split into teams of 5 for a project. How many students are left without a full team?
Four students are left over. Because 4 teams of 5 use 20 students, and 24 minus 20 leaves 4, which is not enough for a fifth team.
My mother's only brother has two daughters. What are those girls to me?
They are your cousins. Because your mother's brother is your uncle, and your uncle's children are your cousins.
A recipe for 4 people needs 2 cups of rice. How much rice do I need for 10 people?
You need 5 cups of rice. Because 2 cups for 4 people means half a cup per person, and 10 times half a cup is 5 cups.
Why do clothes on a line dry slowly on a humid day?
The air is already full of moisture. Because damp air cannot take in much more water, so the water in the clothes evaporates slowly.
Why does the moon seem to change shape over a month?
We see different amounts of its sunlit side. Because the moon moves around the Earth, and as it does, the part lit by the sun that faces us grows and shrinks.
Farhan earns ₹9,000 a month and spends ₹7,200. What fraction of his pay does he save?
He saves one fifth of his pay. Because 9,000 minus 7,200 is 1,800, and 1,800 out of 9,000 is the same as 1 out of 5.
How many minutes are there between 11:45 a.m. and 1:20 p.m.?
There are 95 minutes. Because 11:45 to 12:45 is 60 minutes, 12:45 to 1:00 is 15, and 1:00 to 1:20 is 20, so 60 + 15 + 20 = 95.
Asha, Bilal and Chen each have a different pet: a cat, a dog and a parrot. Asha has no furry pet, and Bilal does not have the dog. Who has the dog?
Chen has the dog. Because Asha has no furry pet, she must have the parrot; Bilal does not have the dog, so he has the cat, which leaves the dog for Chen.
Why does a closed room smell stale after a few days?
No fresh air has come in. Because smells from cooking, people and damp build up in the still air, and without an open window they have nowhere to go.
In a knockout tournament where each loser goes out, 16 teams take part. How many matches are played to find the winner?
Fifteen matches are played. Because each match knocks out exactly one team, and 15 teams must be knocked out to leave one winner.
A packet of 3 soaps costs ₹105, and a single soap costs ₹38. Is the packet a better deal?
Yes, the packet is better. Because ₹105 divided by 3 is ₹35 a soap, which is ₹3 less than buying one at ₹38.
Five painters take 8 days to paint a building. At the same speed, how long would 10 painters take?
They would take about 4 days. Because twice as many painters working at the same speed can do the job in half the time, and half of 8 days is 4.
Why do people sometimes snap at others when they are very hungry or tired?
Hunger and tiredness wear down patience. Because when the body is low on food or rest, small annoyances feel bigger, so people react faster and more sharply than they mean to.
Why does a balloon get bigger when you blow into it?
You push more air inside it. Because the extra air presses on the stretchy rubber from the inside, and the rubber stretches outwards to make room.
Our flight lands at 3:10 p.m., and collecting bags and driving home takes 50 minutes. When will we reach home?
You should reach home at about 4:00 p.m. Because 3:10 plus 50 minutes is exactly 4:00, as long as the bags and traffic take no longer than planned.
Why do many birds migrate before winter?
They move to find food and warmth. Because in cold months insects, fruit and seeds become scarce, so many birds travel to places where food is easier to find.
A garden bed is 6 metres long and 4 metres wide. How many plants fit if each needs 1 square metre?
Twenty-four plants fit. Because the bed's area is 6 times 4, which is 24 square metres, and each plant needs one square metre.
Why is it easier to remember a story than a list of random words?
A story links the words together. Because each event leads to the next, so remembering one part helps you recall what follows, while random words have no links.
Each of 12 guests at Eid lunch gets 2 pieces of sweet, and there are 30 pieces. How many are left over?
Six pieces are left over. Because 12 guests times 2 pieces is 24, and 30 minus 24 is 6.
Why is it wise to carry a water bottle on a long walk in hot weather?
So you can drink before you get too thirsty. Because the body loses water through sweat in the heat, and there may be no place to get water along the way.
The exam is on the 21st and today is the 9th. How many full days are there in between?
There are 11 days in between. Because the days from the 10th to the 20th make 11 days, and both today and the exam day are left out.
A rope ladder hangs from a boat with its lowest rung touching the water. The tide rises 1 metre. How many rungs go under?
None of them go under. Because the boat floats, so it rises with the water, and the ladder rises along with the boat.
Dad is three times as old as Sameer, who is 12. How old was Dad when Sameer was born?
Dad was 24. Because Dad is 3 times 12, which is 36, and 36 minus Sameer's 12 years is 24.
Why does bread go hard when left out, but mouldy in a damp, closed box?
It dries in the open and grows mould in the damp. Because open air pulls water out of the bread and makes it stale, while a damp, closed box keeps it moist, which mould needs to grow.
Ravi travels 22 days a month. Should he buy a ₹40 daily bus ticket each day or a ₹700 monthly pass?
The monthly pass is cheaper. Because 22 days at ₹40 is ₹880, which is ₹180 more than the ₹700 pass.
At noon on a sunny day, why is the beach sand hotter than the sea?
Sand heats up faster than water. Because water needs much more heat to warm up and the sea keeps mixing, while the thin top layer of dry sand soaks up the sun quickly.
A meeting was moved from 2:00 p.m. to one and a half hours later. When does it start now?
It now starts at 3:30 p.m. Because one and a half hours is 1 hour and 30 minutes, and 2:00 plus that is 3:30.
Lena lent Tom ₹300. Tom paid back ₹120 and then ₹90. How much does he still owe?
Tom still owes ₹90. Because 120 plus 90 is 210, and 300 minus 210 is 90.
Why does a cricket ball bounce higher on a hard, dry pitch than on a soft, wet one?
A hard surface gives back more of the ball's energy. Because a soft, wet pitch squashes and soaks up some of the impact, while a hard, dry one pushes the ball back up more strongly.
What is the use of a doormat outside the front door?
It keeps dirt out of the house. Because people wipe their shoes on it, and the mud and dust stay on the mat instead of on the floor inside.
Why do rivers flow towards the sea?
Gravity pulls the water downhill. Because water always moves to lower ground, and the sea is lower than the land around it, so rivers run down towards it.
A clock gains 2 minutes every day. It was set right on Sunday. How far ahead will it be after two weeks?
It will be 28 minutes ahead. Because two weeks is 14 days, and 14 times 2 minutes is 28 minutes.
Why does a steel nail sink while a huge steel ship floats?

The ship's shape lets it push aside a lot of water. Because a hollow, wide ship pushes aside a weight of water greater than its own, so the water holds it up, while a small solid nail pushes aside too little.
If 4 metres of cloth cost ₹480, how much do 7 metres cost?
Seven metres cost ₹840. Because ₹480 divided by 4 is ₹120 a metre, and 7 times 120 is 840.
Why might someone feel nervous about speaking in front of the class, even when they know the topic well?
Speaking to a crowd feels risky. Because they worry about forgetting words or being judged, and that worry makes the heart race even when they are well prepared.
Why do ants walk in a line?
They follow a scent trail. Because ants leave a smell on the ground as they walk, and others follow that smell to the same food, which forms a line.
A train has 12 coaches with 72 seats each. How many passengers can sit?
It can seat 864 passengers. Because 12 times 72 is 864: 10 coaches hold 720, and 2 more hold 144.
Why do dictionaries list words in alphabetical order?
So that any word can be found quickly. Because once you know the spelling, the order tells you exactly where to look, instead of reading the whole book.
Is it better to study for a test a little each day or all in one night?
A little each day usually works better. Because the brain keeps things better when you go over them several times with rest in between, and you are less tired too.
Why are weeds pulled out of a vegetable patch?
So the vegetables get enough water, light and food. Because weeds compete with the crop for these, and if they spread, the vegetables grow weaker.
Three sisters have ages that add up to 30, and each is 2 years older than the next. How old is the eldest?
The eldest is 12. Because the ages must be 8, 10 and 12, which differ by 2 each time and add up to 30.
Why does our breath look like a white cloud on a cold morning?
The water in warm breath turns into tiny drops. Because the cold air cools your breath quickly, and the water vapour in it becomes a small mist you can see.
Why do people cover their mouths when they cough?
To stop germs spreading to others. Because a cough sprays tiny drops into the air, and covering the mouth keeps most of them from reaching people nearby.
Anil starts a task at 10:15. He needs 2 hours of work plus 3 breaks of 10 minutes. When will he finish?
He will finish at 12:45. Because 2 hours of work and 30 minutes of breaks make 2 hours 30 minutes, and 10:15 plus that is 12:45.
A drawer has 5 red and 5 blue socks. In the dark, how many must I take out to be sure of a matching pair?
You must take out 3 socks. Because there are only two colours, the first two might differ, but the third must match one of them.
Why are fireworks set off at night rather than in the day?
They are much easier to see in the dark. Because the bright colours stand out against a black sky, while daylight would wash them out.
A cake takes 35 minutes to bake. If it goes in at 5:40 p.m., when should it come out?
It should come out at 6:15 p.m. Because 5:40 plus 20 minutes is 6:00, and 15 more minutes makes 6:15.
Why do two friends sometimes remember the same trip differently?
Each person notices and keeps different details. Because memory is not a recording; people remember what mattered to them, and the memory changes a little each time it is retold.
Simran's savings of ₹2,000 grow by 5 percent in a year. How much does she gain?
She gains ₹100. Because 5 percent means 5 out of every 100, and there are 20 hundreds in 2,000, so 20 times 5 is 100.
Why is a shadow longest in the early morning and evening?
The sun is low in the sky then. Because low sunlight hits objects at a slant, which stretches their shadows across the ground, while at noon the sun is high and shadows are short.
Our class has 18 girls and 12 boys. What fraction of the class are boys?
Two fifths of the class are boys. Because there are 30 students in all, and 12 out of 30 is the same as 2 out of 5.
Why does a pressure cooker cook dal faster than an open pot?
It cooks at a higher temperature. Because the trapped steam raises the pressure inside, and under higher pressure water boils above 100 degrees, so food cooks faster.
Aunt Shobha is my father's sister. What is her son to my father?
He is your father's nephew. Because a nephew is the son of a person's brother or sister, and Aunt Shobha is your father's sister.
A basketball player scores with 6 of every 10 shots. About how many will she score out of 50?
She will score about 30. Because 50 is 5 times 10, and 5 times 6 is 30, so the same rate gives 30 out of 50.
Why do our ears sometimes pop when a plane takes off?
The air pressure around us changes. Because the pressure outside the ear drops as the plane climbs, and the ear pops when the air inside it evens out with the air outside.
Why do some trees drop all their leaves in dry or cold months?
Dropping leaves saves water. Because leaves lose water into the air, and when water is short or frozen, a tree survives better by shedding them and resting.
Arun buys 3 notebooks at ₹45 each and pays with a ₹200 note. What change does he get?
He gets ₹65 back. Because 3 times 45 is 135, and 200 minus 135 is 65.
If yesterday was Saturday, what day will it be the day after tomorrow?
It will be Tuesday. Because if yesterday was Saturday, today is Sunday, tomorrow is Monday, and the day after that is Tuesday.
When a friend moves away, why can a person feel happy and sad at once?
Both feelings make sense together. Because they are glad for the friend's new chance and grateful for the time they shared, but sad to lose the daily company.
A spider has 8 legs and an ant has 6. How many legs do 4 spiders and 5 ants have altogether?
They have 62 legs. Because 4 spiders have 32 legs, 5 ants have 30 legs, and 32 + 30 = 62.
Why is it often cooler at the top of a hill than at the bottom?
Air gets colder as you go higher. Because air spreads out and cools as it rises, so places at a greater height are usually colder than the valley below.
An office has 48 chairs, and 6 people sit at each table. How many tables are needed to use every chair?
Eight tables are needed. Because 48 chairs split into groups of 6 gives 8 groups, one for each table.
Why do vegetables shrink when they are cooked?
They lose water as they cook. Because heat breaks down the walls of the plant cells, and the water inside escapes as steam or juice, so the pieces get smaller and softer.
A shop offers the third bottle at half price when you buy two. Juice is ₹60 a bottle. What do 3 bottles cost?
Three bottles cost ₹150. Because the first two cost ₹120, the third costs half of ₹60, which is ₹30, and 120 + 30 = 150.
Why does a torch beam look dimmer when the batteries are old?
Old batteries give less power. Because as a battery is used up, it pushes less electric current through the bulb, so the bulb glows more weakly.
Why do teachers ask students to show their working in maths, not just the answer?
It shows how you got the answer. Because the teacher can see where a mistake happened and give marks for the right steps, and you can check your own thinking too.
How many seconds are there in a quarter of an hour?
There are 900 seconds. Because a quarter of an hour is 15 minutes, and 15 times 60 seconds is 900.
One rangoli design uses 250 grams of colour powder. How many designs can be made from 2 kilograms?
Eight designs can be made. Because 2 kilograms is 2,000 grams, and 2,000 divided by 250 is 8.
Why is it a bad idea to share a secret a friend told you in trust?
It can break the friendship. Because your friend trusted you to keep it, and if it spreads, they may feel hurt and stop confiding in you.
Why do plants on a windowsill bend towards the window?
They grow towards the light. Because the shaded side of the stem grows a little faster than the sunny side, which bends the plant towards the window.
A tap drips 1 cup of water every hour. How many cups are wasted in a week?
About 168 cups are wasted. Because there are 24 hours in a day and 7 days in a week, and 24 times 7 is 168.
A bookshelf has 5 shelves with 28 books on each. If 17 books are borrowed, how many are left?
There are 123 books left. Because 5 times 28 is 140, and 140 minus 17 is 123.
Why do people usually sleep better in a dark, quiet room?
There is less to disturb them. Because light and noise keep the brain alert, while darkness and quiet help the body settle into deep sleep.
All of Mrs. Iyer's students passed the exam. Tanvi failed it. Was Tanvi one of Mrs. Iyer's students?
No, she was not. Because every one of Mrs. Iyer's students passed, so a student who failed cannot be one of them.
Why is it smart to pack an umbrella and a light jacket for a hill trip, even in summer?
Hill weather can change quickly. Because hills can turn cold and rainy within an hour, especially in the evening, and these two things take very little space.
Why do younger children often copy what their older siblings do?
They look up to them and learn by watching. Because older siblings seem grown-up and capable, so younger ones copy their words and habits to feel included and to learn.
A swimmer does 4 lengths of a 25-metre pool every minute. How far does she swim in 10 minutes?
She swims 1,000 metres. Because 4 lengths of 25 metres is 100 metres a minute, and 10 minutes at that rate makes 1,000 metres.
Why do forecasts say there is a 70 percent chance of rain instead of a simple yes or no?
Weather cannot be known for certain. Because forecasters can only judge how likely rain is from patterns and measurements, so a percentage tells you how strongly to expect it.
Tejas wants a ₹1,500 bicycle. He has ₹600 and saves ₹225 a week. How many weeks until he can buy it?
He needs 4 more weeks. Because he still needs ₹900, and 4 weeks of ₹225 adds up to exactly ₹900.
Why do many animals have fur or skin that matches their surroundings?
It helps them hide. Because a colour that blends into the ground, snow or trees makes it harder for hunters to spot them, or for their prey to see them coming.
If a printer prints 20 pages a minute, how long will 450 pages take?
It will take 22 and a half minutes. Because 450 divided by 20 is 22.5, so 22 full minutes print 440 pages and the last 10 pages need half a minute.
Why are bananas often sold while still green?
So they ripen on the way to your kitchen. Because bananas keep ripening after they are picked, and green ones survive transport without bruising or going too soft.
Why do people say sorry even when a mistake was small?
It shows they care about the other person. Because even a small mistake can annoy someone, and a quick apology clears the air before it grows into resentment.
Where does sugar go when it is stirred into hot tea?
It dissolves into the tea. Because the sugar breaks into pieces too tiny to see, which spread through the liquid, and heat and stirring make this happen faster.
Rekha's watch shows 4:50, but it is 7 minutes slow. What is the real time?
The real time is 4:57. Because a slow watch shows an earlier time than the real one, so you add the 7 minutes.
Why do mosquitoes increase after the monsoon?
They breed in standing water. Because rain leaves puddles, pots and drains full of still water, and mosquitoes lay their eggs there.
Why do shopkeepers keep sweets near the counter?
People often buy them without planning to. Because customers waiting to pay see them at the last moment, and small, cheap treats are easy to add to the bill.
There are 7 rows of desks with 6 desks in each row, and 5 desks are empty. If each desk seats one student, how many students are present?
There are 37 students present. Because 7 times 6 is 42 desks, and 42 minus the 5 empty ones is 37.
Why do people who play a sport together often become good friends?
They share time, goals and effort. Because training, winning and losing together gives them many shared moments, and working as a team builds trust.
Why do we keep matches and lighters out of small children's reach?
To prevent fires and burns. Because young children are curious and do not yet understand the danger, so they might strike a match and hurt themselves.
A cyclist rides at 12 km an hour. How far does he go in 2 hours 30 minutes?
He goes 30 km. Because 2 hours at 12 km an hour is 24 km, and the extra half hour adds 6 km.
Some people in my building have dogs. Does that mean some dog owners live in my building?
Yes, it does. Because the people in your building who have dogs are dog owners, and they live in your building.
A family of 6 buys new clothes for Pongal, and each set costs ₹850. What is the total?
The total is ₹5,100. Because 6 times 800 is 4,800 and 6 times 50 is 300, and 4,800 + 300 = 5,100.
Why do farmers grow different crops in the same field in different years?
It keeps the soil healthy. Because each crop uses different nutrients, and changing crops stops the soil from running out of one kind and helps control pests.
Why does a team often play better at its home ground?
Home teams have a few advantages. Because they know the ground well, have not had to travel, and hear their own supporters cheering, which can lift their confidence.
Why might two readers form different opinions of the same character?
They bring different lives to the reading. Because each reader judges a character through their own experiences and values, so one may admire a choice that another finds wrong.
Why do bees visit flowers?
They collect nectar and pollen for food. Because bees turn nectar into honey and feed pollen to their young, and while doing so they carry pollen between flowers.
Which is cheaper: ₹15 for a 500 ml bottle of water or ₹25 for a 1 litre bottle?
The 1 litre bottle is cheaper. Because two 500 ml bottles would cost ₹30 for a litre, which is ₹5 more than ₹25.
Why do roads become slippery in the first rain after a long dry spell?
Oil and dust on the road mix with the water. Because weeks of traffic leave oil and grime on the surface, and a little rain turns it into a slick layer until heavier rain washes it away.
Grandma shares ₹1,000 among her 4 grandchildren so that the eldest gets ₹100 more than each of the other three, who get equal shares. How much does the eldest get?
The eldest gets ₹325. Because each of the other three gets ₹225, which makes ₹675, and the eldest's ₹325 brings the total to ₹1,000.
Library period comes every third school day, and the first one is on a Monday. With a five-day school week, on which day is the third library period?
It falls on Tuesday of the next week. Because counting school days, the periods fall on day 1, day 4 and day 7, which are Monday, Thursday and the following Tuesday.
Why are fruits and vegetables washed before eating?
To remove dirt, germs and sprays. Because produce is grown outdoors and handled by many people, so its skin may carry soil and chemicals.
A road map uses 1 cm for 5 km. Two towns are 7.5 cm apart on the map. How far apart are they really?
They are 37.5 km apart. Because each centimetre stands for 5 km, and 7.5 times 5 is 37.5.
How can someone feel lonely in a crowd?
Being near people is not the same as being close to them. Because loneliness comes from missing real connection, so a person can feel alone if no one around them knows or understands them.
A win gives 3 points and a draw gives 1. A team won 5 games and drew 4. How many points does it have?
The team has 19 points. Because 5 wins give 15 points, 4 draws give 4 points, and 15 + 4 = 19.
Why must a fridge door be shut properly?
Otherwise the cold air escapes. Because an open door lets warm air in, so the fridge must work harder, uses more power, and the food may spoil sooner.
If every square is a rectangle, is every rectangle a square?
No, it is not. Because a square is a special rectangle with all four sides equal, but many rectangles have two long sides and two short ones.
Why can we see more stars from a village than from a city?
City lights hide the fainter stars. Because street and building lights brighten the night sky, and faint stars cannot stand out against it, while a village sky stays darker.
Pallavi's phone bill was ₹450 in March and ₹540 in April. By what percentage did it rise?
It rose by 20 percent. Because the bill went up by ₹90, and 90 out of 450 is one fifth, which is 20 percent.
Why do workers take short breaks during a long shift?
Breaks help them stay alert and avoid mistakes. Because attention and energy drop after long stretches of work, and a short rest helps restore them.
A cow gives 12 litres of milk a day. How much does it give in the month of June?
It gives 360 litres. Because June has 30 days, and 30 times 12 litres is 360 litres.
Why does the calendar add an extra day every four years?
To keep the calendar in step with the seasons. Because the Earth takes about 365 and a quarter days to go around the sun, and four quarter days add up to one extra day.
Three friends share a ₹540 taxi fare equally. How much does each one pay?
Each friend pays ₹180. Because ₹540 divided equally among 3 people is ₹180, and 3 times 180 brings it back to 540.
Why do clouds look grey before rain but white on a sunny day?
Rain clouds are thick and full of water. Because thick clouds block much of the sunlight passing through them, so their bottoms look dark grey, while thin clouds scatter light and look white.
Why do schools hold fire drills?
So everyone knows what to do in a real fire. Because practising the way out ahead of time helps people stay calm and leave quickly and safely.
Mum leaves for work at 8:15 a.m. and returns at 5:45 p.m. How long is she away?
She is away for 9 hours 30 minutes. Because 8:15 a.m. to 5:15 p.m. is 9 hours, and 5:15 to 5:45 adds 30 minutes more.
A jug holds 1.5 litres of lassi. How many 250 ml glasses can be filled?
Six glasses can be filled. Because 1.5 litres is 1,500 ml, and 1,500 divided by 250 is 6.
Why does a ball rolling on grass stop sooner than one rolling on a smooth floor?
Grass creates more friction. Because the blades of grass rub against the ball and catch it, slowing it down faster than a smooth floor does.
Should I check my change before leaving the counter?
Yes, it is wise. Because once you walk away, it is hard to show what you were given, and a simple slip can cost you or the shopkeeper money.
Christmas is on 25 December. If today is 30 November, how many days are left until Christmas?
There are 25 days left. Because 30 November to 1 December is 1 day, and 1 December to 25 December is 24 more, which makes 25.
Why do most books have a contents page at the start?
It helps readers find chapters quickly. Because the contents page lists each chapter with its page number, which saves flipping through the whole book.
Why do farmers often wear wide hats when working in the fields?
The hat shades them from the sun. Because a wide brim keeps strong sunlight off the face and neck, which keeps them cooler and protects their skin during long hours outside.
I have more coins than Riya, and Riya has more than Sam. Sam has 10. Could I have exactly 11?
No, you must have at least 12. Because Riya has more than Sam, so she has at least 11, and you have more than Riya, so you have at least 12.
Ten trees are planted in a row with 4 metres between each pair of neighbours. How long is the row from the first tree to the last?
The row is 36 metres long. Because 10 trees have only 9 gaps between them, and 9 times 4 metres is 36 metres.
Why are houses in hot desert areas often built with thick walls?
Thick walls keep the inside cooler in the day. Because they take a long time to heat up in the sun, so by the time the heat passes through, the day is over and the cool night begins.
Why should seat belts be worn even on short car trips?
Accidents can happen on any trip, even a short one. Because a sudden stop throws the body forward, and a belt holds you safely in your seat.
Sunil is paid ₹120 an hour. He worked 6 hours on Monday and 4.5 hours on Tuesday. What did he earn?
He earned ₹1,260. Because 6 plus 4.5 is 10.5 hours, and 10.5 times 120 is 1,260.
Why do people feel proud after finishing a hard task?
They see that their effort paid off. Because finishing something difficult shows them what they can do, and that feeling of success makes the struggle feel worthwhile.
Why do cricket captains look at the pitch and the sky before choosing to bat or bowl first?
Conditions can favour one side at different times. Because a pitch may change as the day goes on, and cloudy weather can help bowlers, so captains pick what suits their team best.
Why do dogs sniff the ground so much on walks?
They learn about the area through smell. Because a dog's nose is far stronger than ours, so scents tell it which animals and people have passed by.
A school trip costs ₹3,600 for a group of 24 students. What is each student's share?
Each student pays ₹150. Because ₹3,600 divided by 24 is 150, and 24 times 150 brings it back to 3,600.
Why should a heavy box be lifted by bending the knees rather than the back?
Bending the knees protects the back. Because the strong leg muscles then do the lifting, and the back stays straight instead of taking a strain.
If sunrise is at 6:12 a.m. and sunset is at 6:48 p.m., how long is the day?
The day is 12 hours 36 minutes long. Because 6:12 a.m. to 6:12 p.m. is 12 hours, and 6:12 to 6:48 adds 36 minutes.
Out of 50 students, 28 like maths, 30 like science and 15 like both. How many like neither?
Seven students like neither. Because 28 + 30 - 15 = 43 students like at least one subject, counting the 15 only once, and 50 minus 43 is 7.
Why do some families dry chillies and papads on the roof in summer?
The summer sun dries them quickly. Because roofs get strong sunshine and moving air, which take the water out of the food so it keeps for months.
Before giving a friend advice, why is it good to listen fully first?
You need to understand the problem first. Because if you jump in early, you may answer the wrong question, and your friend may feel unheard.
Why does the sea taste salty while river water does not?
Salt has built up in the sea over a very long time. Because rivers carry tiny amounts of salt from rocks into the sea, and when sea water evaporates, the salt stays behind.
A rainbow appears only when the sun is behind us and rain is in front. Why?

Raindrops split sunlight into colours and send it back towards us. Because sunlight enters each drop, bends and bounces back, and each colour bends by a different amount, so the colours spread into a band.
Kunal's family drinks 2 litres of milk a day, and milk costs ₹56 a litre. What is the weekly milk bill?
The weekly bill is ₹784. Because 2 litres a day for 7 days is 14 litres, and 14 times 56 is 784.
Why do people often re-read a favourite book?
They enjoy the comfort and notice new things. Because they already know the story, they can relax into it, and as they grow they understand parts they missed before.
There are 3 apples on the table and you take away 2. How many apples do you have?
You have 2 apples. Because the question asks how many you have, and you took 2; the 1 left on the table is not yours.
A watch cost ₹2,000. Its price went up 10 percent and then down 10 percent. Is it back to ₹2,000?
No, it is now ₹1,980. Because a 10 percent rise makes ₹2,200, and 10 percent of 2,200 is ₹220, so the drop leaves ₹1,980.
Why do teams write down what was decided at the end of a meeting?
So everyone remembers the same thing. Because people recall meetings differently, and a written note of decisions and tasks avoids confusion later.
Why do people clean and decorate their homes before festivals?
To welcome the festival in a fresh, bright home. Because guests visit, families gather, and a clean, decorated house makes the occasion feel special.
Why does a bus usually take longer than a car on the same route?
The bus stops often and moves more slowly. Because it picks up and drops passengers at many stops, and a big vehicle needs more time to speed up and turn.
A pot needs 300 ml of water every 2 days. How much water does it need over 30 days?
It needs 4.5 litres. Because 30 days has 15 watering days, and 15 times 300 ml is 4,500 ml, which is 4.5 litres.
How come we get thirstier on hot days?
The body loses more water in the heat. Because people sweat more to stay cool, and thirst is the body's signal to replace that lost water.
A tortoise walks 3 metres a minute. How long does it take to cross a 45-metre garden?
It takes 15 minutes. Because 45 divided by 3 is 15, so it covers 3 metres in each of 15 minutes.
Teasing that seems harmless to one person can hurt another. Why?
People feel things differently. Because a joke may touch something the other person is sensitive about, and the one teasing cannot see how it lands inside them.
What does a team gain by practising set plays again and again?
So players can do them without thinking. Because repeating a move until it is automatic helps the team carry it out quickly and correctly under the pressure of a real match.
